import sys
import math
import sys

MOD = 1000000007
MOD2 = 1007681537
INF = 10**9
LINF = 10**18
sqrt = int(math.sqrt(10**9) + 1

def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        r = a % b
        a = b
        b = r
    return a

def lcm(a, b):
    return a // gcd(a, b) * b

def fpow(n, k, p=MOD):
    r = 1
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            r = r * n % p
        n = n * n % p
        k >>= 1
    return r

def chkmin(a, val):
    if val < a:
        a = val
        return 1
    return 0

def chkmax(a, val):
    if a < val:
        a = val
        return 1
    return 0

def isqrt(k):
    r = int(math.sqrt(k)) + 1
    while r * r > k:
        r -= 1
    return r

def icbrt(k):
    r = int(round(k ** (1/3))) + 1
    while r * r * r > k:
        r -= 1
    return r

def addmod(a, val, p=MOD):
    a = a + val
    if a >= p:
        a -= p
    return a

def submod(a, val, p=MOD):
    a = a - val
    if a < 0:
        a += p
    return a

def mult(a, b, p=MOD):
    return (a * b) % p

def inv(a, p=MOD):
    return fpow(a, p - 2, p)

def sign(x, eps=1e-9):
    if x < -eps:
        return -1
    if x > eps:
        return 1
    return 0

def transform(arr, n, p, invert):
    k = n.bit_length() - 1
    for i in range(k):
        step = 1 << i
        for msk in range(n):
            if msk & step:
                pmsk = msk ^ step
                if not invert:
                    arr[msk] = (arr[msk] + arr[pmsk]) % p
                else:
                    arr[msk] = (arr[msk] - arr[pmsk]) % p

def pow_convol(a, k, p):
    n = len(a)
    if k == 1:
        return a[:]
    if k & 1:
        r = pow_convol(a, k - 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + r[i] * a[j]) % p
        return res
    else:
        r = pow_convol(a, k >> 1, p)
        res = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n - i):
                res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + r[i] * r[j]) % p
        return res

def subset_pow_convol(a, k, p):
    logn = 19
    n = len(a)
    while n != (n & -n):
        n += n & -n
    # allocate dynamic arrays of size logn x n
    fa = [[0] * n for _ in range(logn)]
    fb = [[0] * n for _ in range(logn)]
    fc = [[0] * n for _ in range(logn)]
    for i in range(logn):
        for j in range(n):
            if j < len(a) and (j.bit_count() == i):
                fa[i][j] = a[j]
            else:
                fa[i][j] = 0
            fc[i][j] = 0
        transform(fa[i], n, p, 0)
    for i in range(n):
        va = [0] * logn
        for j in range(logn):
            va[j] = fa[j][i]
        va = pow_convol(va, k, p)
        for j in range(logn):
            fc[j][i] = va[j]
    res = [0] * n
    for i in range(logn):
        transform(fc[i], n, p, 1)
        for j in range(n):
            if j.bit_count() == i:
                res[j] = fc[i][j]
    return res[:len(a)]

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, k, p = map(int, data[:3])
    maxn = 1000005
    fac = [1] * maxn
    for i in range(1, maxn):
        fac[i] = mult(fac[i - 1], i, p)
    ifac = [0] * maxn
    for i in range(maxn):
        ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p)

    f = [0] * (n + 1)
    nn = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        if (n & i) == i:
            t = 0
            for j in range(20):
                if (n >> j) & 1:
                    t <<= 1
                    t |= (i >> j) & 1
            f[t] = i
            nn = t

    if n & 1:
        print(fpow(k, n, p))
        return

    a = [0] * (nn + 1)
    for i in range(nn + 1):
        a[i] = ifac[f[i]]
    res = fpow(k, n, p)
    a = subset_pow_convol(a, k, p)
    res = (res - mult(a[nn], fac[n], p)) % p
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
